blocks.text: 92. And that He should become visible [^irenaeus-demonstration-iv-226] amongst us—for the Son of God became Son of man—and be found of us who before had no knowledge (of Him), the Word Himself says thus in Isaiah: I became manifest to them that sought me not; I was found of them that asked not for me. I said, Behold, here am I, to a race that called not on my name.

irenaeus-demonstration-iv-226.text: Or “manifest,” as in the quotation below.
